title: 第十五章 连吃带拿啊？
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
看到这个消息，叶洛璃刚刚还很开心，美眸当中的激动甚至还未来得及完全消散，就直接愣在原地。

    啊？？？

    领主币，什么领主币啊？

    叶洛璃被秦天这句话搞得一时间还有点没反应过来，好奇之下，自然是直接就在私聊当中把问题给抠了出来。

    【秦天：就是领主币啊！】

    【秦天：这是我买到的元素石，现在你只是让我把这元素石的所有权让给你，来进行交换的，但是我是真的损失了很多领主币啊！】

    看到这样的话，叶洛璃气的娇躯都在颤抖，拳头都捏起来了！

    哪怕在进入领主游戏之前，她从小到大，无论是外貌还是家境，一直都是被人照顾和宠爱的对象，享受的都是众星捧月般的生活。

    哪有受过这样的气啊？！

    这家伙，他花费领主币买到了这颗元素石，那他跟摊主的交易就已经完成了，这时候自己再从他的手上用图纸的代价换取到这颗元素石，情况也是一样的啊！

    这样一来交易也完成了呀！

    交易本身就是双方都答应都同意的情况下，才可以建立的。

    结果这家伙现在所讲的这些，这跟抢有什么分别啊？

    难道这真的不是明抢吗？！

    合着他还想连吃带拿，让自己把图纸给他也就罢了，还想让自己帮他承担购买这颗元素石所花费的领主币？！

    ？开什么玩笑！？！

    就是强盗也不至于做出这样的事情，连吃带拿，吃干抹净吧？！

    她从小到大，还是头一回见到这么无耻的人，合着他跟摊主都赚了，只有自己受伤的世界达成了？！

    叶洛璃这哪能忍啊，这根本就不合理好吗？！

    原本还以为对面能够迅速升级领地，应该也是觉醒了不弱的天赋，像是这种很强的竞争对手，在潜意识里，难免就会想象成一个较为优秀的强大的形象。

    这样的人通常都是骄傲的。

    都有着一定的傲气，眼高于顶，更何况这作为全服首个二级领地的人，应该更加会存在这种特质才对！
content_en:
Seeing this news, Ye Luoli was very happy just now, but the excitement in her beautiful eyes didn't even have time to completely dissipate, and she just froze on the spot.

    ah? ? ?

    Lord coins, what kind of lord coins?

    Ye Luoli was so confused by Qin Tian's words that she didn't react for a while. Out of curiosity, she naturally asked the question directly in the private chat.

    [Qin Tian: It’s the Lord Coin! 】

    [Qin Tian: This is the elemental stone I bought. Now you just asked me to give you the ownership of this elemental stone in exchange, but I really lost a lot of lord coins! 】

    Seeing such words, Ye Luoli's delicate body was shaking with anger and her fists were clenched!

    Even before she entered the lord game, she had always been cared for and pampered by others, regardless of her appearance or family background, and she had enjoyed a life filled with stars.

    How have you ever been so angry? !

    This guy, he spent Lord Coins to buy this elemental stone, then his transaction with the stall owner has been completed. At this time, he exchanges the price of the blueprint for this elemental stone from his hand, and the situation is the same!

    In this way, the transaction is completed!

    The transaction itself can only be established with the consent of both parties.

    As a result, what this guy is talking about now, what is the difference between this and robbery?

    Isn't this really a robbery? !

    He still wanted to eat and take it, so he just asked me to give him the blueprint. He also wanted me to help him bear the lord coins spent to purchase this elemental stone? !

    ? What a joke! ? !

    Even a robber wouldn't do such a thing, including eating and taking, eating and wiping clean, right? !

    This is the first time she has seen such a shameless person since she was a child. With him and the stall owner making money together, she has achieved a world where she is the only one who is hurt? !

    How can Ye Luoli tolerate this? This is simply unreasonable, okay? !

    I originally thought that the opponent could quickly upgrade his territory and must have awakened a strong talent. For such a strong competitor, subconsciously, he would inevitably imagine a better and more powerful image.

    Such people are usually proud.

    They all have a certain degree of arrogance and are above the top, not to mention that as the first second-level territory in the server, people should have this trait even more!
title_en: Chapter 15: Eat and take it too?
